name: scroll-area
title: Scroll Area
purpose: Constrain overflowing content in a labelled native scroll viewport with Balsa scrollbar treatment.
avoidFor: Hidden essential content without a visible scroll cue
accessibility: The focusable viewport is a labelled region.
Native browser wheel, touch, pointer, and keyboard scrolling remain intact.
Programmatic methods operate the same native viewport.
commonMistakes: Nesting same-axis scroll regions without need.
Using edge fades where they obscure important content.
